en: Taking that internship in a remote mountain lab might not have been the best idea.
zh: 在深山裡的實驗室中實習，可能不是一個好主意。

notes.zh: the best part of my day：我一天中最美好的片刻
notes.example: Morning coffee by the window is the best part of my day.

en: Pulling that lever with the skull symbol just to see what it did probably wasn't so smart, either,
zh: 拉下畫有骷髏符號的控制桿，看看會發生什麼事，或許也不是個聰明的想法。

en: but now is not the time for regrets because you need to get away from these mutant zombies fast.
zh: 但現在，已經沒時間後悔了，因為你得趕緊逃離這些突變的殭屍。

en: With you are the janitor, the lab assistant, and the old professor.
zh: 與你同行的，有管理員、實驗室助理和一位老教授，

en: You've gotten a headstart, but there's only one way to safety: across an old rope bridge spanning a massive gorge.
zh: 雖然你們已經領先一步，但要安全逃離，還需要：跨越大峽谷上的一座老舊吊橋。

notes.zh: run across someone：偶然遇見某人
notes.example: I ran across an old friend at the bookstore.

en: You can dash across in a minute, while the lab assistant takes two minutes.
zh: 你衝過吊橋只需要 1 分鐘，然而實驗室助理需要 2 分鐘。

notes.zh: run across someone：偶然遇見某人
notes.example: I ran across an old friend at the bookstore.

notes.zh: （錄音或拍片）每一次錄製（between takes：錄製空檔）
notes.example: The band kept improvising between takes.

en: The janitor is a bit slower and needs five minutes, and the professor takes a whole ten minutes,
zh: 管理員稍慢一些，需要 5 分鐘，而教授需要整整 10 分鐘，

notes.zh: （錄音或拍片）每一次錄製（between takes：錄製空檔）
notes.example: The band kept improvising between takes.

en: holding onto the ropes every step of the way.
zh: 因為他走每一步都要緊握著繩索來前進。

en: By the professor's calculations, the zombies will catch up to you in just over 17 minutes,
zh: 根據教授的計算，在 17 分鐘後，殭屍就會追上你們，

en: so you only have that much time to get everyone across and cut the ropes.
zh: 你只有這麼多的時間，讓所有人通過吊橋並剪掉繩索。

notes.zh: run across someone：偶然遇見某人
notes.example: I ran across an old friend at the bookstore.

en: Unfortunately, the bridge can only hold two people at a time.
zh: 不幸的是，吊橋同一時間只能承載兩個人。

notes.zh: 承重、容納
notes.example: Are you sure that shelf can hold all these books?

en: To make matters worse, it's so dark out that you can barely see,
zh: 更糟糕的是，天色太暗，讓你伸手不見五指，

en: and the old lantern you grabbed on your way only illuminates a tiny area.
zh: 而你手中的老舊油燈，只能照亮一個小範圍。

en: Can you figure out a way to have everyone escape in time?
zh: 你能想出讓每個人及時逃脫的方法嗎？

en: Remember: no more than two people can cross the bridge together,
zh: 記住：不能超過兩人同時走在吊橋上；

notes.zh: come together：順利成形、水到渠成
notes.example: Everything came together right before the deadline.

en: anyone crossing must either hold the lantern or stay right next to it,
zh: 跨越吊橋時，若不帶著油燈，就得走在提燈者旁。

notes.zh: 承重、容納
notes.example: Are you sure that shelf can hold all these books?

en: and any of you can safely wait in the dark on either side of the gorge.
zh: 而所有人都可以安全地待在漆黑的峽谷兩端。

en: Most importantly, everyone must be safely across before the zombies arrive.
zh: 最重要的是，所有人必須在殭屍抵達前安全地通過吊橋。

notes.zh: run across someone：偶然遇見某人
notes.example: I ran across an old friend at the bookstore.

en: Otherwise, the first zombie could step on the bridge while people are still on it.
zh: 否則，當殭屍一踏上橋時，橋上的人會使吊橋負荷過重而斷裂。

en: Finally, there are no tricks to use here.
zh: 最後，不能用任何花招。

en: You can't swing across, use the bridge as a raft, or befriend the zombies.
zh: 你不能用繩索擺盪過去，也不能把橋做成木筏，或者和殭屍當朋友。

notes.zh: run across someone：偶然遇見某人
notes.example: I ran across an old friend at the bookstore.

en: Pause the video now if you want to figure it out for yourself!
zh: 如果你想要自己找出答案，請按下暫停鈕。

en: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1 At first it might seem like no matter what you do,
zh: 還有 3 秒、 2 秒、 1 秒、一開始，你可能會認為無論怎麼試，

en: you're just a minute or two short of time, but there is a way.
zh: 始終會差個一、兩分鐘，但確實是有辦法的。

en: The key is to minimize the time wasted by the two slowest people by having them cross together.
zh: 關鍵就在於：讓最慢的兩人走在一起，來減少他們所需要花的時間。

notes.zh: come together：順利成形、水到渠成
notes.example: Everything came together right before the deadline.

en: And because you'll need to make a couple of return trips with the lantern,
zh: 而且，要有人提著油燈走回來這總共需要兩趟，

en: you'll want to have the fastest people available to do so.
zh: 你需要讓跑得最快的人來做這件事，

en: So, you and the lab assistant quickly run across with the lantern, though you have to slow down a bit to match her pace.
zh: 所以，你先和實驗室助理提著油燈快速通過，然而你必須放慢一些來配合他的速度。

notes.zh: run across someone：偶然遇見某人
notes.example: I ran across an old friend at the bookstore.

en: After two minutes, both of you are across, and you, as the quickest, run back with the lantern.
zh: 兩分鐘後，你們兩人都通過吊橋，然後跑得最快的你，再迅速提著油燈返回，

notes.zh: run across someone：偶然遇見某人
notes.example: I ran across an old friend at the bookstore.

en: Only three minutes have passed. So far, so good.
zh: 這樣只花了三分鐘。到目前為止都相當順利。

en: Now comes the hard part.
zh: 最難的部分來了。

en: The professor and the janitor take the lantern and cross together.
zh: 教授和管理員提著油燈一起過橋，

notes.zh: come together：順利成形、水到渠成
notes.example: Everything came together right before the deadline.

en: This takes them ten minutes since the janitor has to slow down for the old professor who keeps muttering
zh: 這花了他們 10 分鐘，因為管理員必須為了老教授放慢腳步，

notes.zh: （錄音或拍片）每一次錄製（between takes：錄製空檔）
notes.example: The band kept improvising between takes.

en: that he probably shouldn't have given the zombies night vision.
zh: 教授喃喃自語抱怨著：他當初不該讓殭屍擁有夜視能力。當他們跨越吊橋時，

en: By the time they're across, there are only four minutes left, and you're still stuck on the wrong side of the bridge.
zh: 當他們跨越吊橋時，只剩下 4 分鐘，而你仍困在對岸。

notes.zh: run across someone：偶然遇見某人
notes.example: I ran across an old friend at the bookstore.

notes.zh: don't take this the wrong way：別誤會我的意思（說真話前超實用緩衝句）
notes.example: Don't take this the wrong way, but the second version reads better.

en: But remember, the lab assistant has been waiting on the other side, and she's the second fastest of the group.
zh: 但是記住，實驗室助理已經在另一邊待命，而她是隊伍中跑第二快的人。

notes.zh: just need a second：請稍等我們一下
notes.example: Sorry, we just need a second to check the menu.

en: So she grabs the lantern from the professor and runs back across to you.
zh: 所以她從教授手中拿起油燈，快速跑回去你那邊。

notes.zh: run across someone：偶然遇見某人
notes.example: I ran across an old friend at the bookstore.

en: Now with only two minutes left, the two of you make the final crossing.
zh: 現在只剩下 2 分鐘，你們兩位最後一次過橋，

en: As you step on the far side of the gorge, you cut the ropes and collapse the bridge behind you, just in the nick of time.
zh: 當你踏上峽谷的另一側，你剪斷繩索，摧毀身後的吊橋，時間剛好趕上。

en: Maybe next summer, you'll just stick to the library.
zh: 或許，明年夏天你只會想泡在圖書館內。
